ModMetaData.name: RimRound Rework WIP
ModMetaData.author: Niwatori401
ModMetaData.description:
Work-in-progress rework of RimRound for RimWorld 1.6.
Updated 17 October 2026: unified settings under Options > Mod options > RimRound; audited controls and display sizes; repaired social/assisted feeding and prepared-meal selection; correctly sized nude bodies when clothing art is missing.
Weight-related extra rest drain is reduced by 75% in an operating hoverchair and by 100% while stationary, immobile, carried or seated in a vehicle. Vanilla rest needs remain. Vehicle Framework and Vanilla Vehicles Expanded passenger feeding have been checked in the tested versions.
Obese and above receive natural/tended injury recovery at 110% of the ordinary rate after compensating for enlarged body-part health. Lardy and above resist new food poisoning. Both effects follow current eligible adult weight stage.
Male and female bodies, friendly and hostile pawns, prisoners and slaves are enabled by default at ages 18-1000. Existing custom switches and limits are preserved, apart from the one-time old 200-year upper-limit migration.
Anthrosonae is now fully supported. Base-mod adult appearances retain their coats, colours, head features and fitted tails/wings across supported RimRound body artwork and weight stages. Third-party addon content retains native fallback.
Includes the earlier food-density/digestion rework, complete Gain meals and food machinery. Regional body parts, new head/chin growth and new fitted outfits remain future work.
This is a WIP. Broader save-reference reliability and sustained-performance/release checks remain open.
